abyssal_slime.description: Abyssal slimes surface from the deep abyssal zone only once every couple of decades. Because they are so rarely seen, seamen have often mistaken them for monsters in the past. Many legends with sea monsters were just an encounter with the friendly abyssal slime.

fusionHints: Fusion: Golem Slime + Runic Slime
Fusion: Guardian Slime + Astral Slime
Fusion: Bioluminescent Slime + Shark Slime
→ Planet Slime: Prism Slime + Astral Slime
→ Angel Slime: Guardian Slime + Astral Slime

aurora_slime.description: The processes that create the Aurora Borealis phenomena also happen in the internal organs inside the aurora slime. Its unknown why they do this, however scientists suspect that the aurora slime may be using the Earth's magnetic field to feed.

barnacle_slime.description: Barnacle slimes live far longer lives than humans do. The oldest recorded barnacle slime is 350 years old, and continues to live on today. The barnacles on its head grow so large due to the excess of nutrients in the slime.
fusionHints: → Bioluminescent Slime: Phosphor Slime + Barnacle Slime

bat_slime.description: Just like bats, bat slime guano sells for a high price. However, the reason is because of a natural resource like nitrogen, but instead because its used as an incense in many rituals around the world.
fusionHints: Fusion: Moon Slime + Berry Slime
Fusion: Power Slime + Metal Slime
→ Drone Slime: Battery Slime + Bee Slime
→ Teddy Slime: Bear Slime + Plush Slime

bee_slime.description: This striped slime communicates with its fellow colony members in a language that sounds like humming a tune. According to linguists, the grammatical structure is similar to chinese.
fusionHints: → Pollen Slime: Bee Slime + Flower Slime
→ Drone Slime: Battery Slime + Bee Slime
→ Honey Slime: Bee Slime + Candy Slime

berry_slime.description: Berry slimes are only found in a specific season of the year. They secrete a sweet substance that, when paired with peanut butter, makes for a delicious sandwich.
fusionHints: → Bat Slime: Moon Slime + Berry Slime
Fusion: Phosphor Slime + Barnacle Slime
→ Angler Slime: Bioluminescent Slime + Shark Slime
→ Pearlescent Slime: Urchin Slime + Bioluminescent Slime
Fusion: Planet Slime + Moon Slime
Fusion: Shark Slime + Skeleton Slime

butterfly_slime.description: Butterfly slimes come in many different colors and patterns. There are even some butterfly slime species that, when put together, their patterns form a larger image. Also, butterfly slimes love nectar.
fusionHints: → Firefly Slime: Butterfly Slime + Phosphor Slime
→ Honey Slime: Bee Slime + Candy Slime
→ Catfish Slime: Cat Slime + Finned Slime
→ Nyan Slime: Neon Slime + Cat Slime
→ His Purness Slime: Cat Slime + Royal Slime

catfish_slime.description: It's said that much of the world's government is controlled by catfish slimes. The longer the whiskers on a catfish slime, the great intelligence they have. At birth they are already twice as smart as the average human.
fusionHints: Fusion: Cat Slime + Finned Slime
→ Pot Slime: Clay Slime + Fire Slime
→ Golem Slime: Spirit Slime + Clay Slime
→ Runic Slime: Crystal Slime + Clay Slime

clownfish_slime.description: The clownfish slime's favorite food is cherries. While cherries cannot be found in the slime's natural habitat, they are similar in taste to the 'sea cherry', but in a more elevated manner.
fusionHints: Fusion: Reef Slime + Finned Slime

coral_slime.description: The coral slime lives in the shallow coral reefs in tropical areas. These slimes are very territorial, and battle with each other using their coral growths for mates and territory.
fusionHints: → Reef Slime: Coral Slime + Kelp Slime
→ Runic Slime: Crystal Slime + Clay Slime
→ Opal Slime: Moon Slime + Crystal Slime
Legendary fusion: Firefly Slime + Pearlescent Slime + Ancient Slime + Hologram Slime
Fusion: Battery Slime + Bee Slime
→ Jetpack Slime: Drone Slime + Ro-bo Slime

finned_slime.description: The fins on the side of their body may look simple at first, but actually are extremely complex appendages that has as much control as human hands do.
fusionHints: → Catfish Slime: Cat Slime + Finned Slime
→ Clownfish Slime: Reef Slime + Finned Slime
→ Prism Slime: Sand Slime + Fire Slime
→ Pot Slime: Clay Slime + Fire Slime

firefly_slime.description: When the summer gets too hot, firefly slimes migrate to cooler regions in huge flocks during the night. The horde of fireflies slimes is so immense and large, it can be seen from space.
fusionHints: Fusion: Butterfly Slime + Phosphor Slime

flower_slime.description: A sociable slime that frolicks around the grassy meadows. The flowers that grow on their heads come in many forms and form a symbiotic relationship with the slime.
fusionHints: → Pollen Slime: Bee Slime + Flower Slime
→ Sunflower Slime: Sun Slime + Flower Slime
→ Hologram Slime: Glitch Slime + Nyan Slime
Fusion: Spirit Slime + Clay Slime
→ Ancient Slime: Golem Slime + Runic Slime
→ Ro-bo Slime: Golem Slime + Power Slime

grass_slime.description: A carefree slime that spends most of its day sleeping in the sunlight.
fusionHints: → Wind Slime: Nimbus Slime + Grass Slime
→ Samara Slime: Grass Slime + Wind Slime
Fusion: Spirit Slime + Royal Slime
→ Angel Slime: Guardian Slime + Astral Slime
Fusion: Cat Slime + Royal Slime
Fusion: Glitch Slime + Nyan Slime
Fusion: Bee Slime + Candy Slime
Fusion: Drone Slime + Ro-bo Slime

kelp_slime.description: The kelp slime has massive social anxiety and spends most of its time hiding in the kelp forest. Sometimes, kelp slimes even move their kelp growths in front of their eyes to dissappear from a conversation.
fusionHints: → Reef Slime: Coral Slime + Kelp Slime
→ Slime Slime: Kelp Slime + Metal Slime
→ Battery Slime: Power Slime + Metal Slime
→ TV Slime: Neon Slime + Metal Slime
→ Slime Slime: Kelp Slime + Metal Slime

moon_slime.description: The moon slime is rarely seen, and only appears on nights with full moons. When the sun comes up, they vanish. The crater shaped indent on its head is different for each moon slime.
fusionHints: → Phosphor Slime: Pollen Slime + Moon Slime
→ Bat Slime: Moon Slime + Berry Slime
→ Black Hole Slime: Planet Slime + Moon Slime
→ Opal Slime: Moon Slime + Crystal Slime
→ TV Slime: Neon Slime + Metal Slime
→ Nyan Slime: Neon Slime + Cat Slime

nimbus_slime.description: A amicable slime that spends its time floating in the sky. Because its body is so light, it rarely ever comes to the surface.
fusionHints: → Wind Slime: Nimbus Slime + Grass Slime
→ Tempest Slime: Nimbus Slime + Shark Slime
Fusion: Neon Slime + Cat Slime
→ Hologram Slime: Glitch Slime + Nyan Slime
Fusion: Moon Slime + Crystal Slime
Fusion: Urchin Slime + Bioluminescent Slime

phosphor_slime.description: On some nights in June, phosphor slimes come to the surface from their cave hideaways to socialize and mate. For towns nearby fields where this occurs, it's common for couples to watch this spectacle together. Depending on the region, phosphor slimes may also be orange.
fusionHints: Fusion: Pollen Slime + Moon Slime
→ Firefly Slime: Butterfly Slime + Phosphor Slime
→ Bioluminescent Slime: Phosphor Slime + Barnacle Slime

pirate_slime.description: While the pirate slime's costume display may fool your average joe, scientists know that the slime is sweet as pie. The slime actually has two eyes, so the eyepatch is purely decorative. Slimes can regenerate any body part.

fusionHints: Fusion: Prism Slime + Astral Slime
→ Black Hole Slime: Planet Slime + Moon Slime
→ Teddy Slime: Bear Slime + Plush Slime

pollen_slime.description: During the spring season, the natural charge built up on these slimes attracts pollen to their bodies, which builds up like a layer of fur. Depending on the nearby plant species, the color of these slimes vary. Rarely, you may see a pollen slime with no pollen, which is actually purple.
fusionHints: Fusion: Bee Slime + Flower Slime
→ Phosphor Slime: Pollen Slime + Moon Slime
Fusion: Clay Slime + Fire Slime
→ Battery Slime: Power Slime + Metal Slime
→ Ro-bo Slime: Golem Slime + Power Slime
Fusion: Sand Slime + Fire Slime
→ Planet Slime: Prism Slime + Astral Slime

rainbow_slime.description: Stories from those that have seen the rainbow slime said great fortune has always came to them after their encounter. As time has passed, the rainbow slime has become a symbol of fortune and luck and is often paraded as a balloon during New Years.

reef_slime.description: The coral skeleton horns on the reef slime are simply because the coral decided to move to the skin of the reef slime. Over time, the reef slime will be completely covered and when it dies, it will join the existing reef.
fusionHints: Fusion: Coral Slime + Kelp Slime
→ Clownfish Slime: Reef Slime + Finned Slime
Fusion: Golem Slime + Power Slime
→ Jetpack Slime: Drone Slime + Ro-bo Slime

→ Guardian Slime: Spirit Slime + Royal Slime
→ His Purness Slime: Cat Slime + Royal Slime
Fusion: Crystal Slime + Clay Slime

samara_slime.description: While real samara seeds use their wing-shaped geometry as a seed disperson technique, the samara slime uses it to get to fruit hanging from tall trees.
fusionHints: Fusion: Grass Slime + Wind Slime

sand_slime.description: The sand slime's body is almost completely made out of sand and water. Because of the natural result of sand's filtering properties, the core of the slime is a small water reservoir. As a result, many small animals such as crabs or starfish can live inside a sand slime.
fusionHints: → Sandcastle Slime: Sand Slime + Royal Slime
→ Prism Slime: Sand Slime + Fire Slime

sandcastle_slime.description: Sandcastle slimes are descended from fortress slimes, which were alive during the medieval era. These slimes, while a sliver of the might of a fortress slime, which were believed to be as tall as humans, still carry the same resilient and loyal personality.
fusionHints: Fusion: Sand Slime + Royal Slime

shark_slime.description: Shark slimes can swim at astouding speeds, even faster than actual sharks. The gills on the side of their body are purely decorative, slimes do not require lungs or gils to respirate as they absorb it through their skin.
fusionHints: → Bone Shark Slime: Shark Slime + Skeleton Slime
→ Angler Slime: Bioluminescent Slime + Shark Slime
→ Tempest Slime: Nimbus Slime + Shark Slime

skeleton_slime.description: Don't be distracted by the slime's cute appearance. One touch of its toxic gelatinous body is enough poison to kill a horse. If you encounter this slime, it's best not to stay for long.
fusionHints: → Bone Shark Slime: Shark Slime + Skeleton Slime
Fusion: Kelp Slime + Metal Slime
→ Guardian Slime: Spirit Slime + Royal Slime
→ Golem Slime: Spirit Slime + Clay Slime

sun_slime.description: This slime radiates warm sunlight in a similar fashion to the sun, making it very interesting to scientists as a possible source of energy.
fusionHints: → Sunflower Slime: Sun Slime + Flower Slime

sunflower_slime.description: The flower on its head can actually tilt a couple degrees so that it faces towards the sun.
fusionHints: Fusion: Sun Slime + Flower Slime
Fusion: Bear Slime + Plush Slime
Fusion: Nimbus Slime + Shark Slime
Fusion: Neon Slime + Metal Slime

urchin_slime.description: It's better not to get on the bad side of an urchin slime. These spiny slimes have a short temper, and they'll never forget a grudge. Keeping these slimes as pets is risky but rewarding, as they also have fierce loyalty.
fusionHints: → Pearlescent Slime: Urchin Slime + Bioluminescent Slime

wind_slime.description: Wind slimes are very serious slimes. They expect perfection out of other slimes, and so get dissappointed easily. These slimes have developed wing-like appendages that allows them to travel at speeds upwards of 300 mph.
fusionHints: Fusion: Nimbus Slime + Grass Slime
→ Samara Slime: Grass Slime + Wind Slime
